about: Sun and Earth azimuth/elevation from JPL Horizons (DE441; airless apparent, i.e. light-time and aberration corrected, no refraction; site in the MEAN_ME frame on the 1,737.4 km sphere like LOLA) at the pinned story sites, hourly, plus whether each body's centre clears the local LOLA terrain horizon seen from a 2 m eye (Computed). Azimuth is degrees from local north through east; elevation is degrees above the local horizontal. Use sun_direction() in terrain_heightfield.gd to turn a row into a Godot light direction.
citation: JPL Horizons On-Line Ephemeris System, https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/ ; LOLA horizon from PGDA products 78 and 90
